note: San Francisco street furniture modelled from parameters by scripts/assets/build-street-props-v2.py in Blender: no imported, generated or traced geometry and no downloaded imagery. Dimensions from the sources listed in dimensionSources; where none was readable the v1 slot is kept (see each row's fitToSlot and deviation). Frame: glTF Y up, origin at the foot unless the row says otherwise, +X along the street, -Z toward the carriageway. Materials share one albedo and one metallic-roughness JPEG per kind; `body` is always first.
